purpose: Ninth-pass official and first-party verification for five existing Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction pages, first-party operator pages, Companies House records and local-authority pages are promoted. Third-party directory listings are not promoted. Auction sale results do not alone prove Land Registry completion, current occupation or exact parcel geometry.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

rows.address: 100 Central Road, Worcester Park, London, KT4 8HU
rows.resolved_fact: The current Acuitus page identifies individuals trading as Kimberley's Nail Design under a ten-year lease from 28 September 2023 and states that the tenant has occupied the shop since 2013. Sutton's official planning route remains available. No public first-party operator or Companies House route was obtained; current directory entries were treated as third-party and not promoted.

rows.address: Halfords Autocentre, Laleham Road, Staines-upon-Thames, TW18 2DY
rows.resolved_fact: Halfords' current first-party location page identifies the operating Universal Tyres Staines autocentre at Laleham Road, TW18 2DY, exposes current opening times and accepts service bookings. Spelthorne's official planning page, last modified 6 March 2026, still states that Public Access is unavailable because of technical issues. Current operation is reconfirmed, while exact planning records remain unavailable.

Savills' primary auction record reports the property sold for a GBP 385,000 hammer price on 8 April 2025 and describes it as fully let to WH Smith Retail Holdings Limited until 9 December 2027, with a tenant break option in 2026. This independently strengthens the Acuitus tenancy and sale history. It does not prove Land Registry completion, whether the 2026 break was exercised or current store operation; no usable first-party WHSmith exact-address page was obtained.

rows.address: Idlewells Shopping Centre, Market Street, Sutton-in-Ashfield, Nottinghamshire, NG17 1BP
rows.resolved_fact: Idlewells' current first-party site states that the centre is open, contains more than 45 shops and publishes a current shop directory. Ashfield District Council separately confirms that Idlewells Indoor Market is open, contains 34 stalls and remained fully open during planned 2026 asbestos-removal work. Current centre and market operation are strongly verified, although the full investment tenancy and vacancy schedule was not read.

rows.address: David Ethan House, 715 North Circular Road, London, NW2 7AH
rows.resolved_fact: Companies House records multiple active businesses at 715 North Circular Road after the auction's historical vacant-possession statement, including NORTH CIRCULAR AUTOS LTD at the exact street address and A&A CAR SERVICE LTD at Unit 5 London Group Business Park, 715 North Circular Road. Active property companies are also registered at Unit A. These records strongly contradict treating the entire address as currently vacant, but do not identify the exact David Ethan House demise, occupational rights or freehold boundary.
